result_text:
`all_files.zip` is now built from the configured aspect names, so renaming the `buildAndDeployment` aspect no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config.

The change is in `exportZips()` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It used to read five fixed file names such as `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. A renamed aspect wrote its loose file under a different name, so the read failed and the stack trace followed. Now it takes the main, test, generated, build and deployment, and other aspects in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName`, the same helper that writes the loose files.

With the default config the entries are unchanged and in the same order. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written as before when `git-history.txt` exists.

I also added the `NamedSourceCodeAspect` import to that file.
